## Hypothesis

The shotgun scalper stage4 grinder identified a parameter set that improves edge capture by tightening profit targets and stops, reducing time exposure, and adjusting for volatility and strike selection. The goal is to better capture the asymmetric payoff of J's winner days while limiting damage on loser days, addressing the observation that the baseline engine captures winners but suffers excessive losses on certain loser days.

## Mechanism

Enter on the shotgun scalper signal (volume ratio > threshold combined with price action triggers) with the following parameters:
- Take profit at 75% of premium (`tp_premium_pct=0.75`)
- Stop loss at 35% of premium (`stop_premium_pct=-0.35`)
- Time stop after 12 minutes (`time_stop_min=12`)
- Strike selection: ITM-2 (`strike_offset=2`)
- Chandelier profit‑lock arm at 60% of ATR‑derived threshold (`chandelier_arm_pct=0.6`)
- Volume ratio filter threshold set to 1.2 (`vol_ratio_threshold=1.2`)
Exit logic: first of TP, SL, or time stop hits; after TP1 (if implemented) move runner to breakeven and trail via chandelier.
